In Next.js, the built-in next/image component extends the traditional HTML img element to automatically optimize images for performance, layout shift prevention, and modern formats like WebP and AVIF."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Why Use next/image?"},{"order":4,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Automatic Size Optimization: Automatically serves the correct image size for each device using modern image formats."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Visual Stability: Prevents Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) automatically by requiring explicit width and height or layout fills."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Faster Page Loads: Resources are lazy-loaded by default, meaning images outside the viewport only load as the user scrolls near them."},{"order":7,"type":"subheading","text":"Configuring Remote Patterns"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"When loading images from a remote source, Next.js requires you to configure remote patterns in your next.config.js file.
